title: gRPC Web
definition: gRPC is a high-performance RPC framework built on HTTP/2 using Protocol Buffers (protobufs). gRPC-Web allows browser clients to communicate directly with gRPC backend services using binary data instead of heavy JSON.
simpleExplanation: JSON is a heavy, slow, text-based language. Protobufs are a super-compressed binary language that computers can read infinitely faster.

answers.question: What is the main tradeoff of gRPC?
answers.answer: Usually a tradeoff between Server CPU usage, TTFB (Time to First Byte), and Client CPU usage.
